{
  "dataset_name": "pricerunner",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "vendor_id_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Unit-scaled vendor_id with clipping to the observed fit-split bounds.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "identifier_scale",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives the linear margin a stable vendor-position signal without raw identifier scale dominating.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((vendor_id - 1.0) / (368.0 - 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cluster_id_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Unit-scaled cluster_id with clipping to the observed fit-split bounds.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "identifier_scale",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds coarse catalog-position signal on a stable scale for SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((cluster_id - 1.0) / (47525.0 - 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vendor_cluster_log_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-compressed ratio of cluster_id to vendor_id, clipped to a unit interval.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "identifier_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth nonlinear projection of catalog position relative to vendor position, useful for linear boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(cluster_id / (vendor_id + 1.0)) / np.log1p(47525.0 / 2.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_portable_personal_device_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of a pocketable personal electronic item; 1 means strong evidence from handset, SIM, unlocked-network, storage-capacity, or similar cues.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_title_attribute",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Helps distinguish compact personal electronics from large household goods through a smooth text-derived cue.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "title_viewing_display_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of a large viewing display; 1 means strong evidence from screen size, resolution, HDR, panel, remote, smart-entertainment, or similar cues.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_title_attribute",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a dense signal for screen-centered entertainment products that a linear model can weight directly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "title_image_capture_optics_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of still/video capture gear; 1 means strong evidence from lens, optical zoom, megapixel, sensor, kit, or similar imaging cues.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_title_attribute",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Supplies an interpretable imaging-equipment axis that supports cleaner linear separation from other electronics.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "title_processor_component_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of standalone computing silicon or board-level component; 1 means strong evidence from processor, socket, GHz, cores, cache, Xeon, Core, Ryzen, or similar hardware cues.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_title_attribute",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a continuous component-hardware cue for products whose titles are dominated by technical specifications.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "title_food_heating_cavity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of a compact food-heating appliance; 1 means strong evidence from wattage, grill, turntable, cavity litres, defrost, cooking program, or similar cues.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_title_attribute",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth kitchen-heating signal that helps a linear model isolate compact cooking appliances.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "title_cold_storage_presence_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of temperature-controlled food storage; 1 means strong evidence from frost-free, under-counter, larder, chest, upright, capacity-litre, or similar cold-storage cues.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_title_attribute",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives a broad cold-storage axis while leaving subtype detail to a companion profile feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "title_cold_storage_temperature_profile",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Signed semantic profile from product_title only: -1 means fresh-chill or larder emphasis, 0 means mixed, paired, ambiguous, or no cold-storage evidence, and 1 means subzero or frozen-goods emphasis.",
      "value_range": [
        -1.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_title_profile",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Splits cold-storage rows along fresh-chill versus subzero emphasis while preserving a smooth linear axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "title_wet_cleaning_presence_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score from product_title only: 0 means no evidence of a water-using cleaning appliance; 1 means strong evidence from load kg, spin rpm, place settings, cutlery, wash program, integrated fit, or similar wet-cleaning cues.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_title_attribute",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a broad wet-cleaning appliance signal that is smooth enough for a linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "title_wet_cleaning_load_profile",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Signed semantic profile from product_title only: -1 means tableware or place-setting emphasis, 0 means ambiguous or no wet-cleaning evidence, and 1 means fabric, laundry, spin, or load-weight emphasis.",
      "value_range": [
        -1.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_title_profile",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Distinguishes fabric-care wording from tableware-cleaning wording using a single continuous axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
